# Tsunami presentation source audit (2026-10-23)

The raw files are unchanged captured relay frames or official HTML/JSON/CAP responses.
Each case records its original path, SHA256 and official URL where available.
HTML/CAP cases normalize source fields into the existing relay contract without
changing the raw source. They are not claimed to be captured relay JSON frames.
Tests use original issue times. Only separate, explicitly labelled Mock models
receive current presentation timestamps when injected for visual review.
No warning levels, wave values, coordinates or station positions are invented.
The INCOIS 2025 WAVEAMPLITUDE variant has no explicit unit in that JSON:
its value is retained as source text and is not promoted to a numeric metre reading.
